text:
The winch, and what a strut weighs.

The first cut of this film got two things wrong. It showed a hand winch. The winch is electric: twelve volts, off a battery, rated 1,500 pounds, 6.7 kilonewtons. And it weighed the frame with the solver's estimate, 7.2 kilograms a strut. The owner's struts, weighed, are 15 to 22: 2.1 to 3.0 times as heavy. So a triangle is 45 to 66 kilograms, and the frame 1,800 to 2,640. Every load from here on is the heavier one.
